term: subsistence compatible with an incomplete part
definition: SubsistsInWeakSense excludes inherence as an accident or material form, exactly the first sense of hoc aliquid in ad 1 and the qualified per se existens of ad 2. It does not exclude being a part, every dependence, or being the human body’s form. It does not assert an ability to think without phantasms or survival after bodily death.
